name: import_document
description: Ingest an on-disk Markdown file into the OPEN session (the file-ingress half compose_document lacks: compose takes an inline string only). Reads the file under the workspace jail, then runs the identical compose pipeline (strict compile gate, quotas, template-seed check, inline-span splitting), so the result is byte-equal to composing the same Markdown inline. sessionId is strictly required: the tool never auto-creates sessions (fresh templated document: new_document first, then import; existing file: open_document first, then import). Accepts .md/.markdown/.txt; .html/.htm refuse with E_VALIDATION (convert to Markdown first, same verdict as CLI import); .docx refuses with E_VALIDATION naming open_document (open .docx files directly). Outside-jail reads fail E_SANDBOX, missing files E_IO, oversize files E_LIMIT. Optional allowedDir (image refs), template (report|memo|blank seed check), and styleGuide (same attach semantics as compose_document). Optional dollarMath (default false) treats $...$ as inline math; off by default because prices and shell text can look like math. Example {"sessionId":"sess_abc","path":"documents/notes.md"} -> compose envelope.
